name: DetectIntuneDrift
label: Detect Intune Drift
helpText: Flags every Intune policy in the tenant that is not covered by a baseline template applying to it (matched by display name across ALL baselines). Each unmanaged policy is its own deviation: accept it to tolerate a tenant-specific policy, or deny it to queue it for deletion. Report-only - nothing is ever changed automatically.
executiveText: Watches for device management policies created outside the agreed baseline - for example by a local admin - and raises each one for review, so unauthorized or forgotten configuration never accumulates unnoticed.
